hardware: Local: RTX 2080 Ti 11 GiB; i7-10700K; 32 GiB RAM; llama.cpp b10964. API models remote.
units: 24 tasks per logical setup. Cost per 1,000 copies of this trial mix, not 1,000 new measured tasks. Support jobs excluded from foreground figures.
billing: Haiku uncached list-price estimate at USD0.10/M input and0.50/M output; cache charges/discounts unavailable. Jev provider-reported. Local APIUSD0 excludes hardware/electricity.
method: Original stock prompts/tools/decisions in a fixture replay, not installed Core. Eight summaries per Support model are reused; neutral/command outputs reused across Support settings. Exact unchanged Main request uses same response for Jev off/on to avoid cache/sampling confounds. Command acknowledgement and audio excluded for both treatments.
limits: Small synthetic corpus; task reference success, not general intelligence or gameplay acceptance.
One bounded world-closure follow-up preserved all earlier trials and retained unaffected observations.
Stock hosted default not identified or benchmarked; native Core closed/refused.
Direct Anthropic Support is a candidate test, not a stock configuration route.
Haiku/source-role matrix is separate from previous broader-model/extra-helper cohorts.
